scale.statement: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength at 22 µm (2.242e-05 m), Holocene age 0 Ma.

chronoseries_contrast.predecessor_state: Equal-diffusion / pre-melanocyte collar at the same Holocene age. Cross term D_v f_u + D_u g_v is negative, sigma_max < 0, and the 22.42 µm mode is absent.
chronoseries_contrast.this_state: Inhibitor-outranging Schnakenberg kinetics select k_c^2 = 3112/259 in the slot length unit, i.e. lambda_c = 2.242e-05 m.
chronoseries_contrast.not_a_successor: Haupaix et al. 2018 somite-spaced yellow/black bands are a longer macro prepattern on the embryonic dorsum. They bound the integument this micro-mode is painted into. They are not a later chronospecies.
chronoseries_contrast.parameter_isolation: Nominal (a, b, D_u, D_v, seed) = (0.07, 0.93, 0.035, 1.85, 3157). The repository somite-stripe script uses beta_A = 0.22, d = 20, seed 2018 and is not reused.

kinetics.du_dt: a - u + u^2 v + div(D_u grad u)
kinetics.dv_dt: b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian v
kinetics.source: Schnakenberg 1979, as a phenomenological within-feather activator-inhibitor system (Prum & Williamson 2002; Shh/Bmp2 signs from Harris et al. 2005).

equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
turing_conditions: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 > 4 D_u D_v det J
equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic on the 22.42 µm detail patch (interior of a barb field). The Holocene portrait is a display envelope, not a no-flux boundary of the PDE.

specimen.creator: 孫鋒 林 (Lin Sun-feng), Taipei, Taiwan
specimen.scale_bar_note: The portrait has no micron scale bar. Absolute 22.42 µm is the model's critical wavelength, not a length read off these pixels. The photograph anchors plumage texture class: vermiculated brown-buff streaks on a Holocene bird.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952: diffusion-driven instability and a critical wavenumber.
Schnakenberg 1979: the two-species kinetics integrated here.
Prum & Williamson 2002: within-feather pigment patterns (bars, spots, paired dots, ocelli) can be produced by follicular reaction-diffusion.
Harris et al. 2005: Shh activates itself and Bmp2; Bmp2 represses Shh, on the feather epithelium.
Haupaix et al. 2018 and Inaba & Chuong 2020: Japanese quail carries both a macro (somite / body) pigment pattern and a micro (within-feather) pattern.
reconstructed_in_script: Slot-specific Schnakenberg parameters whose linear wavelength is exactly 2.242e-05 m.
A Du sweep of that wavelength, an equal-diffusion ablation, and a mildly anisotropic display run whose streaks are oriented along the body axis.
Plumage-mask segmentation of the Yehliu photograph and a high-frequency composite that places the simulated micro-mode inside the Holocene silhouette.
does_not_claim: Does not claim the Yehliu pixels were measured at 22.42 µm.
Does not claim Schnakenberg rates are fitted Shh/Bmp2 biochemical constants.
Does not claim a geological transition from a named fossil chronospecies: the series has one Holocene node.
